items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts? ... And who were the trumpets then? Tatti Trumpets were Joe Keyes, Smith and myself.

ctx.x: Now Bumps and Lester Young made some records together. So he must have been pretty good to play against Lester.
Yes, well Bumps lasted quite a long time.
